data: NVIDIA's net income for fiscal 2025 (the year ended January 26, 2025) was about $72.88 billion, up roughly 145% from $29.76 billion in fiscal 2024. Tesla's net income for fiscal 2025 (the calendar year ended December 31, 2025) is something I can't state with confidence from memory, since its full-year results were reported after the period I know well. For reference, Tesla earned about $7.13 billion in 2024 (GAAP, attributable to common stockholders) and $15.0 billion in 2023. If Tesla's 2025 figure landed near $4 to $7 billion, NVIDIA's would be roughly 10 to 18 times larger. Using the 2024 Tesla figure of $7.13 billion as a rough proxy, NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 income would be about 10.2 times larger. I'd recommend checking Tesla's 10-K for the exact 2025 figure before relying on the multiple.
